newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Rains delay wheat harvesting.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Rains delay wheat harvesting.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf wheat basis bids were little changed as harvesting delays helped to keep business slow, dealers said.
Rains in central Mississippi slowed the soft red winter wheat harvest and led to renewed concern about possible disease problems if wet conditions persist, which prompted caution among buyers.
Weekly state reports, issued Monday, showed five percent of Mississippi's wheat crop was harvested, as of Sunday.
Rains also delayed hard red winter wheat harvesting in Texas and Oklahoma.
Corn and soybean basis levels were little changed.
